verdict.rationale: The Department of State's own incorporation page says online filing is available on its website, and it describes the post-filing email acknowledgement with a PDF filing receipt and optional add-on copies. That establishes that the core formation transaction can be completed online. The transport-level block on the filing host is bot-blocking, not evidence that online filing fails, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of the online filing flow, and an explicit description of online fee payment (the card-payment instructions describe submitting an authorization form to the Division).

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Online filing is available on the Department of State's website.
After filing online, you will receive an email filing acknowledgement with your filing receipt attached in PDF format.
you will have the option of requesting additional services, such as a plain copy, certified copy or certificate of existence.
